One song, then evacuation ↗

Really Good Time’s set at Green Door Store ended after just one song: we had to evacuate the venue because of a leak in the roof. The timeline keeps the scheduled 14:00–14:30 slot; the actual finish time wasn’t recorded.

01:30 / THAT’S YOUR DAY

After midnight means Sunday 25 October. Times show the scheduled slots; personal notes record what happened on the day.

03 / POCKET NOTES

Keep the day simple.

Leave room to move.

Gaps below are time between scheduled sets, not walking estimates. Allow for the route, queues and venue capacity, especially the 20-minute MLEKO → SNAYX change.

Make the breaks count.

You have 40 minutes after Iguana Death Cult and another 40 after Dove Ellis. The longest pause is already after dark; plan food and water around your own pace.

One room for the finale.

From 22:30 onwards, Painkiller, Alien Chicks and Cowboy Hunters all play The Hope and Ruin. Each set has a 30-minute gap before the next.
